capabilities: create, rename, delete, and activate multiple playlists
navigate notes sequentially with previous, next, and play-from-start commands
mark the current note and later return to the marked position
reorder the queue by drag and drop or Alt+Arrow keys
import playlists from wiki links in a note and export playlists to Markdown
extras: The in-app UI is currently localized in Chinese while command names remain in English; beta installation via BRAT is mentioned.
motivation: Built for sequential reading workflows such as reviewing a series of notes, reading a book chapter by chapter, or working through a learning path.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to queue a set of notes into an ordered reading sequence and keep track of your position across sessions.
summary: Playlist-based navigation plugin that turns sets of notes into ordered playlists for sequential reading with progress tracking and a sidebar panel.
